instrument: IMAGINE detector on HFIR CG4D (lite 4x4-grouped and full-resolution panels)
apply_with: quasi_laue_reduction.detcal.apply_detcal (Mantid LoadIsawDetCal silently ignores the IMAGINE IDF, whose rectangular panels are unnamed children of bankNN assemblies)
base_geometry: IDF embedded in the lite files (valid from 2025-10-01), lite pixel centres corrected to their 4x4 group centroids

calibrant.runs: IPTS-37331 even runs 2022-2156 (68 runs, axis0 = 70-270 deg in 3 deg steps; odd runs are goniometer moves)

model: D: relative yaw of array 2 (banks 61-108) about the vertical axis through the sample; vertical shift of each array; horizontal (x, z) translation of each array; sample fixed at the origin; goniometer axis, U0 and per-run angle offsets fitted
uncertainty_note: formal 1-sigma; residuals within a run are correlated, so true uncertainties are likely 2-3x larger; the relative yaw ranged -0.76 to -1.17 deg depending on which other terms were free

validation.metric: fraction of held-out peaks (every other run) indexed within 0.35 deg, per-run angles refitted
validation.note: per-panel in-plane shifts (stage E) did not improve held-out indexing and are not included
